import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, Border, Side, PatternFill, numbers
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from copy import copy
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "2024 Fall Music Tour P&L"

# ── Styles ──
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'), right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'), bottom=Side(style='thin')
)
bottom_border = Border(bottom=Side(style='thin'))
double_bottom = Border(bottom=Side(style='double'))
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F4E79", end_color="1F4E79", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
section_fill = PatternFill(start_color="D6E4F0", end_color="D6E4F0", fill_type="solid")
section_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=11, color="1F4E79")
bold_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=11)
normal_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=11)
title_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=16, color="1F4E79")
subtitle_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="1F4E79")
asof_font = Font(name="Calibri", italic=True, size=11, color="808080")
total_fill = PatternFill(start_color="E2EFDA", end_color="E2EFDA", fill_type="solid")
net_fill = PatternFill(start_color="C6EFCE", end_color="C6EFCE", fill_type="solid")

USD_FMT = '$#,##0.00'
USD_FMT_PCT = '$#,##0.00'

# ── DATA ──
# Revenue data
revenue_stops = [
    ("Oct 7, 2024",   "London",    "UK",      230754,  0.20),
    ("Oct 9, 2024",   "Paris",     "France",  175880,  0.15),
    ("Oct 10, 2024",  "Paris",     "France",  168432,  0.15),
    ("Oct 12, 2024",  "Barcelona", "Spain",   125932,  0.24),
    ("Oct 14, 2024",  "Madrid",    "Spain",   110823,  0.24),
    ("Oct 16, 2024",  "Munich",    "Germany", 99117,   0.15825),
    ("Oct 18, 2024",  "Berlin",    "Germany", 132812,  0.15825),
]

# Expenses: (category, subcategory, tour_mgr, prod_co)
exp_data = [
    # Band and Crew
    ("Band and Crew", "Sound Technician", 8256, 0),
    ("Band and Crew", "Tour Coordinator", 6904, 0),
    ("Band and Crew", "Fees & Per Diem (10 members)", 0, 91000),
    # Hotel & Restaurants
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "London", 8388, 14232),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Paris", 15653, 22296),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Barcelona", 5445, 8168),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Madrid", 5113, 8776),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Munich", 6369, 12040),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Berlin", 6592, 13226),
    # Other Tour Costs
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Agency Commission", 114812.50, 0),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Insurance", 22024, 0),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Other", 4819, 0),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Petty Cash", 0, 8000),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Fees", 0, 1679),
    # Other Travel Costs
    ("Other Travel Costs", "Private Jet", 341000, 0),
    ("Other Travel Costs", "Transfer Cars", 4237, 0),
    ("Other Travel Costs", "Car Service", 0, 2976),
]

# Build category subtotals
from collections import OrderedDict
cat_order = ["Band and Crew", "Hotel & Restaurants", "Other Tour Costs", "Other Travel Costs"]
cat_subs = OrderedDict()
for c in cat_order:
    cat_subs[c] = {"tm": 0, "pc": 0}
for cat, desc, tm, pc in exp_data:
    cat_subs[cat]["tm"] += tm
    cat_subs[cat]["pc"] += pc

# ── WRITE REPORT ──
row = 1

# Title block
ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value="2024 Fall Music Tour")
c.font = title_font
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
row += 1

ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value="Profit & Loss Statement")
c.font = subtitle_font
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
row += 1

ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value="As of December 31, 2024")
c.font = asof_font
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
row += 2

# Column widths
col_widths = [6, 26, 14, 14, 16, 16, 16, 16]
for i, w in enumerate(col_widths, 1):
    ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

# ── Helper functions ──
def write_hr(r, cols=8):
    for c in range(1, cols+1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=c)
        cell.border = Border(bottom=Side(style='hair', color="BFBFBF"))

def apply_border(r, c1, c2, b=thin_border):
    for cc in range(c1, c2+1):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = b

# ═══════════════ REVENUE SECTION ═══════════════
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="REVENUE")
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=13, color="1F4E79")
c.fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")
row = r + 1

# Revenue column headers
rev_headers = ["", "Date", "City", "Country", "Gross Revenue\n(USD)", "Withholding\nTax Rate", "Withholding\nTax (USD)", "Net Revenue\n(USD)"]
r = row
for i, h in enumerate(rev_headers, 1):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=i, value=h)
    c.font = header_font
    c.fill = header_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
    c.border = thin_border
ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 36
row = r + 1

# Revenue data rows
total_gross = 0
total_wht = 0
total_net = 0
for stop in revenue_stops:
    date_str, city, country, gross, rate = stop
    wht = round(gross * rate, 2)
    net = gross - wht
    total_gross += gross
    total_wht += wht
    total_net += net
    
    r = row
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="").border = thin_border
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=date_str).font = normal_font
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2).border = thin_border
    
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=city).font = normal_font
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).border = thin_border
    
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4, value=country).font = normal_font
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).border = thin_border
    
    c_gross = ws.cell(row=r, column=5, value=gross)
    c_gross.number_format = USD_FMT
    c_gross.font = normal_font
    c_gross.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
    c_gross.border = thin_border
    
    # Rate display
    rate_display = f"{rate*100:.3f}%" if country == "Germany" else f"{rate*100:.0f}%"
    c_rate = ws.cell(row=r, column=6, value=rate_display)
    c_rate.font = normal_font
    c_rate.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
    c_rate.border = thin_border
    
    c_wht = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value=wht)
    c_wht.number_format = USD_FMT
    c_wht.font = normal_font
    c_wht.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
    c_wht.border = thin_border
    
    c_net = ws.cell(row=r, column=8, value=net)
    c_net.number_format = USD_FMT
    c_net.font = normal_font
    c_net.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
    c_net.border = thin_border
    
    row = r + 1

# Total Revenue row
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=4)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="TOTAL GROSS REVENUE")
c.font = bold_font
c.fill = total_fill
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = total_fill
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border

c = ws.cell(row=r, column=5, value=total_gross)
c.number_format = USD_FMT; c.font = bold_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')

c = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value=round(total_wht, 2))
c.number_format = USD_FMT; c.font = bold_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')

c = ws.cell(row=r, column=8, value=round(total_net, 2))
c.number_format = USD_FMT; c.font = bold_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
row = r + 1

# Net Revenue line
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=4)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="TOTAL NET REVENUE")
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="006100")
c.fill = net_fill
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = net_fill
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border

c = ws.cell(row=r, column=8, value=round(total_net, 2))
c.number_format = USD_FMT
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="006100")
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
row = r + 2

# ═══════════════ EXPENSES SECTION ═══════════════
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="EXPENSES")
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=13, color="1F4E79")
c.fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
row = r + 1

# Expense headers
exp_headers = ["", "Description", "", "", "Tour Manager\n(USD)", "Production Co.\n(USD)", "Combined\n(USD)", ""]
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=7, end_row=r, end_column=8)
for i, h in enumerate(exp_headers, 1):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=i, value=h)
    c.font = header_font
    c.fill = header_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
    c.border = thin_border
ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 36
row = r + 1

# For the expense section, we use cols:
# 1: spacer, 2-4: merged for description, 5: Tour Mgr, 6: Prod Co, 7-8: merged for Combined

grand_tm = 0
grand_pc = 0

for cat in cat_order:
    # Category header row
    r = row
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=cat)
    c.font = bold_font
    c.fill = section_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
    for cc in range(1, 9):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = section_fill
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
    row = r + 1
    
    cat_tm = 0
    cat_pc = 0
    for ed in exp_data:
        if ed[0] != cat:
            continue
        _, desc, tm, pc = ed
        cat_tm += tm
        cat_pc += pc
        
        r = row
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=f"  {desc}")
        c.font = normal_font
        c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', indent=1)
        c.border = thin_border
        for cc in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
            ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
        
        for ci, val in [(5, tm), (6, pc)]:
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=ci, value=val if val != 0 else None)
            c.number_format = USD_FMT
            c.font = normal_font
            c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
            c.border = thin_border
        
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=7, end_row=r, end_column=8)
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value=tm + pc)
        c.number_format = USD_FMT
        c.font = normal_font
        c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
        c.border = thin_border
        row = r + 1
    
    # Category subtotal
    r = row
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=f"Subtotal — {cat}")
    c.font = bold_font
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
    for cc in range(1, 9):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = PatternFill(start_color="F2F2F2", end_color="F2F2F2", fill_type="solid")
    
    for ci, val in [(5, cat_tm), (6, cat_pc)]:
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=ci, value=val)
        c.number_format = USD_FMT; c.font = bold_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
    
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=7, end_row=r, end_column=8)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value=cat_tm + cat_pc)
    c.number_format = USD_FMT; c.font = bold_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
    
    grand_tm += cat_tm
    grand_pc += cat_pc
    row = r + 1

# Total Expenses
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value="TOTAL EXPENSES")
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12)
c.fill = total_fill
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = total_fill
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border

for ci, val in [(5, grand_tm), (6, grand_pc)]:
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=ci, value=val)
    c.number_format = USD_FMT
    c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')

ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=7, end_row=r, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value=grand_tm + grand_pc)
c.number_format = USD_FMT
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12)
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
row = r + 2

# ═══════════════ NET INCOME ═══════════════
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="NET INCOME")
c.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=13, color="1F4E79")
c.fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
row = r + 1

net_income = round(total_net, 2) - (grand_tm + grand_pc)

# Net income detail rows
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value="Total Net Revenue")
c.font = normal_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
for cc in range(1, 9):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=7, end_row=r, end_column=8)
c = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value=round(total_net, 2))
c.number_format = USD_FMT; c.font = normal_font; c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
row = r + 1

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, Border, Side, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from collections import OrderedDict

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "2024 Fall Music Tour P&L"

# ── Styles ──
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'), right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'), bottom=Side(style='thin')
)
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F4E79", end_color="1F4E79", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
section_fill = PatternFill(start_color="D6E4F0", end_color="D6E4F0", fill_type="solid")
bold_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=11)
normal_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=11)
title_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=16, color="1F4E79")
subtitle_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="1F4E79")
asof_font = Font(name="Calibri", italic=True, size=11, color="808080")
total_fill = PatternFill(start_color="E2EFDA", end_color="E2EFDA", fill_type="solid")
net_fill = PatternFill(start_color="C6EFCE", end_color="C6EFCE", fill_type="solid")
gray_fill = PatternFill(start_color="F2F2F2", end_color="F2F2F2", fill_type="solid")
section_header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="BDD7EE", end_color="BDD7EE", fill_type="solid")

USD_FMT = '$#,##0.00'

# ── DATA ──
revenue_stops = [
    ("Oct 7, 2024",   "London",    "UK",      230754,  0.20),
    ("Oct 9, 2024",   "Paris",     "France",  175880,  0.15),
    ("Oct 10, 2024",  "Paris",     "France",  168432,  0.15),
    ("Oct 12, 2024",  "Barcelona", "Spain",   125932,  0.24),
    ("Oct 14, 2024",  "Madrid",    "Spain",   110823,  0.24),
    ("Oct 16, 2024",  "Munich",    "Germany", 99117,   0.15825),
    ("Oct 18, 2024",  "Berlin",    "Germany", 132812,  0.15825),
]

exp_data = [
    ("Band and Crew", "Sound Technician", 8256, 0),
    ("Band and Crew", "Tour Coordinator", 6904, 0),
    ("Band and Crew", "Fees & Per Diem (10 members)", 0, 91000),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "London", 8388, 14232),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Paris", 15653, 22296),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Barcelona", 5445, 8168),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Madrid", 5113, 8776),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Munich", 6369, 12040),
    ("Hotel & Restaurants", "Berlin", 6592, 13226),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Agency Commission", 114812.50, 0),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Insurance", 22024, 0),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Other", 4819, 0),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Petty Cash", 0, 8000),
    ("Other Tour Costs", "Fees", 0, 1679),
    ("Other Travel Costs", "Private Jet", 341000, 0),
    ("Other Travel Costs", "Transfer Cars", 4237, 0),
    ("Other Travel Costs", "Car Service", 0, 2976),
]

cat_order = ["Band and Crew", "Hotel & Restaurants", "Other Tour Costs", "Other Travel Costs"]

# ── HELPERS ──
def merge_and_fill(ws, r, c1, c2, val, font, fill, align):
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=c1, end_row=r, end_column=c2)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=c1, value=val)
    c.font = font
    c.alignment = align
    for cc in range(c1, c2 + 1):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).fill = fill
        ws.cell(row=r, column=cc).border = thin_border
    return c

def fill_cell(ws, r, col, val, font, fill, align, nf=None):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=col, value=val)
    c.font = font
    c.fill = fill
    c.alignment = align
    c.border = thin_border
    if nf:
        c.number_format = nf
    return c

# ── WRITE REPORT ──
row = 1

# Title block
merge_and_fill(ws, row, 1, 8, "2024 Fall Music Tour", title_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
row += 1
merge_and_fill(ws, row, 1, 8, "Profit & Loss Statement", subtitle_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
row += 1
merge_and_fill(ws, row, 1, 8, "As of December 31, 2024", asof_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
row += 2

# Column widths
col_widths = [3, 30, 14, 14, 16, 16, 16, 16]
for i, w in enumerate(col_widths, 1):
    ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

# ═══════════════ REVENUE ═══════════════
r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 1, 8, "REVENUE", Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=13, color="1F4E79"),
               section_header_fill, Alignment(horizontal='left'))
row = r + 1

# Revenue headers
rev_headers = ["", "Date", "City", "Country", "Gross Revenue\n(USD)", "Withholding\nTax Rate", "Withholding\nTax (USD)", "Net Revenue\n(USD)"]
r = row
for i, h in enumerate(rev_headers, 1):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=i, value=h)
    c.font = header_font
    c.fill = header_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
    c.border = thin_border
ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 36
row = r + 1

# Revenue data
total_gross = 0
total_wht = 0
total_net = 0
for stop in revenue_stops:
    date_str, city, country, gross, rate = stop
    wht = round(gross * rate, 2)
    net = gross - wht
    total_gross += gross
    total_wht += wht
    total_net += net

    r = row
    fill_cell(ws, r, 1, "", normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
    fill_cell(ws, r, 2, date_str, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
    fill_cell(ws, r, 3, city, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
    fill_cell(ws, r, 4, country, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
    fill_cell(ws, r, 5, gross, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
    rate_display = f"{rate*100:.3f}%" if country == "Germany" else f"{rate*100:.0f}%"
    fill_cell(ws, r, 6, rate_display, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='center'))
    fill_cell(ws, r, 7, wht, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
    fill_cell(ws, r, 8, net, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
    row = r + 1

# Gross Revenue total
r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 1, 4, "TOTAL GROSS REVENUE", bold_font, total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
fill_cell(ws, r, 5, total_gross, bold_font, total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
fill_cell(ws, r, 7, round(total_wht, 2), bold_font, total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
fill_cell(ws, r, 8, round(total_net, 2), bold_font, total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
row = r + 1

# Net Revenue
r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 1, 4, "TOTAL NET REVENUE",
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="006100"),
               net_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
fill_cell(ws, r, 8, round(total_net, 2),
          Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="006100"),
          net_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
row = r + 2

# ═══════════════ EXPENSES ═══════════════
r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 1, 8, "EXPENSES",
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=13, color="1F4E79"),
               section_header_fill, Alignment(horizontal='left'))
row = r + 1

# Expense headers
exp_headers = ["", "Description", "", "", "Tour Manager\n(USD)", "Production Co.\n(USD)", "Combined\n(USD)", ""]
r = row
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=2, end_row=r, end_column=4)
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=7, end_row=r, end_column=8)
for i, h in enumerate(exp_headers, 1):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=i, value=h)
    c.font = header_font
    c.fill = header_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
    c.border = thin_border
ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 36
row = r + 1

grand_tm = 0
grand_pc = 0

for cat in cat_order:
    # Category header
    r = row
    merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, cat, bold_font, section_fill, Alignment(horizontal='left'))
    for cc in [5, 6, 7, 8]:
        fill_cell(ws, r, cc, "", bold_font, section_fill, Alignment(horizontal='left'))
    row = r + 1

    cat_tm = 0
    cat_pc = 0
    for ed in exp_data:
        if ed[0] != cat:
            continue
        _, desc, tm, pc = ed
        cat_tm += tm
        cat_pc += pc

        r = row
        merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, f"  {desc}", normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
        fill_cell(ws, r, 5, tm if tm != 0 else None, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
        fill_cell(ws, r, 6, pc if pc != 0 else None, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
        merge_and_fill(ws, r, 7, 8, tm + pc, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'))
        ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = USD_FMT
        row = r + 1

    # Category subtotal
    r = row
    merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, f"Subtotal — {cat}", bold_font, gray_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
    fill_cell(ws, r, 5, cat_tm, bold_font, gray_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
    fill_cell(ws, r, 6, cat_pc, bold_font, gray_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
    merge_and_fill(ws, r, 7, 8, cat_tm + cat_pc, bold_font, gray_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
    ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = USD_FMT
    grand_tm += cat_tm
    grand_pc += cat_pc
    row = r + 1

# Total Expenses
r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, "TOTAL EXPENSES",
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12), total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
fill_cell(ws, r, 5, grand_tm, Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12), total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
fill_cell(ws, r, 6, grand_pc, Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12), total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'), USD_FMT)
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 7, 8, grand_tm + grand_pc,
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12), total_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = USD_FMT
row = r + 2

# ═══════════════ NET INCOME ═══════════════
net_income = round(total_net, 2) - (grand_tm + grand_pc)

r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 1, 8, "NET INCOME",
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=13, color="1F4E79"),
               section_header_fill, Alignment(horizontal='left'))
row = r + 1

r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, "Total Net Revenue", normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 7, 8, round(total_net, 2), normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'))
ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = USD_FMT
row = r + 1

r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, "Total Expenses", normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='left'))
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 7, 8, grand_tm + grand_pc, normal_font, PatternFill(), Alignment(horizontal='right'))
ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = USD_FMT
row = r + 1

r = row
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 2, 4, "NET INCOME",
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=14, color="006100"),
               net_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
merge_and_fill(ws, r, 7, 8, net_income,
               Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=14, color="006100"),
               net_fill, Alignment(horizontal='right'))
ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = USD_FMT
row = r + 2

# ── Notes ──
notes = [
    "(1) All figures are reported in USD. Income data sourced from Tour Manager; no separate income records from Production Company.",
    "(2) Foreign withholding tax applied at source per US Tax Treaties: UK 20%, France 15%, Spain 24%, Germany 15.825%.",
    "(3) Itinerary details are illustrative only. All entities are fictional.",
    "(4) Reporting completed January 2025, as of December 31, 2024.",
]
for n in notes:
    r = row
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=8)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=n)
    c.font = Font(name="Calibri", italic=True, size=9, color="808080")
    row += 1

# ── Page setup ──
ws.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'
ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0

# ── Freeze panes ──
ws.freeze_panes = 'A5'

# Save
output_path = "2024_Fall_Music_Tour_PL_Report.xlsx"
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Report saved to {output_path}")

print(f"\nVerification:")
print(f"  Total Gross Revenue:       ${total_gross:,.2f}")
print(f"  Total Withholding Tax:     ${round(total_wht, 2):,.2f}")
print(f"  Total Net Revenue:         ${round(total_net, 2):,.2f}")
print(f"  Tour Manager Expenses:     ${grand_tm:,.2f}")
print(f"  Production Co. Expenses:   ${grand_pc:,.2f}")
print(f"  Combined Total Expenses:   ${grand_tm + grand_pc:,.2f}")
print(f"  NET INCOME:                ${net_income:,.2f}")

# Detailed breakdown
print(f"\nCategory breakdown:")
for cat in cat_order:
    tm = sum(e[2] for e in exp_data if e[0] == cat)
    pc = sum(e[3] for e in exp_data if e[0] == cat)
    print(f"  {cat}: TM=${tm:,.2f}  PC=${pc:,.2f}  Combined=${tm+pc:,.2f}")
